user.title: Connect to myQ Community
user.description: Sign in with the email and password you use in the myQ Community app. myQ will then send you a one-time code.

otp.title: Enter your one-time code
otp.description: myQ sent a code by {method} to {destination}. Enter it below.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to myQ Community again
reauth_confirm.description: The saved login for {email} no longer works. Enter your password; myQ will send a new one-time code.

error.invalid_code: That code didn't work. Check it and try again.
error.login_expired: The login expired before the code was accepted. Sign in again to get a new code.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach myQ. Try again later.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.

abort.already_configured: This account is already set up.
